text:
maria: quick sync - need a final call on quota reconciliation approach for Dedicated pools. two competing asks from finance vs infra.
ash: finance wants deterministic hourly reconciliation so invoices match usage windows. infra prefers event-based reconciliation to avoid heavy batch jobs.
devon: runtime constraints: we can emit per-pool token deltas every minute. batch billing once an hour is cheap to implement. biggest complexity is carryover accounting when pools spill into opportunistic lanes.
ralph: product note: customers care about predictable "carryover" behavior — they expect some buffer to handle bursts, but not unlimited credit accumulation.
maria: proposal: hour-aligned reconciliation + cap carryover to 3x hourly allocation. keep a leaky-bucket meter that emits minute deltas; billing charges only if sustained overage > 60m.
ash: that maps well to finance. how do we prevent gaming (burst then idle to avoid charges)?
devon: implement a rolling window weighted by usage: a 2-hour EMA for effective consumption used for billing trigger. quick pseudocode: 
```
effective = 0
alpha = 0.25  # 2-hour smoothing on 1-min ticks
for each minute: effective = alpha*usage + (1-alpha)*effective
if effective > allocation and window > 60m: mark overage
```
ralph: good. also need opt-out for sensitive tenants so they never use opportunistic lanes. opt-out must be explicit during onboarding and reflected in billing.
billing-bot: ticket CREATED: BILL-778 "Dedicated: quota recon + carryover cap" assigned to @ash
ash: i'll own billing integration. timeline: hour-aligned recon + carryover cap in next sprint, EMA-based billing trigger GA+1.
maria: decision: ship hour-aligned reconciliation, 3x carryover cap, minute-metering telemetry, opt-out flag at GA. EMA-based smoothing and anti-gaming heuristics deferred to GA+1. owners: devon (runtime), ash (billing), ralph (defaults). any objections?
devon: ok from runtime.
ralph: ok. i'll surface default carryover in docs and onboarding flow.
maria: i'll update roadmap and notify cs to coordinate customer expectations. follow-up doc in confluence link will have examples and numbers.
